Mitch Hedberg - Half-hour Comedy Central special

I remember the summer I got hugely into Mitch. I was working a camp as a teenager, and the other counselors and I would quote his bits constantly. It didn't even have to make sense in context or include an entire quote. Anytime someone asked me a question that started with "how", my response was almost always "with grill marks!" The kids had some downtime every day after lunch for about an hour (usually so the counselors could get in a nap), and we sat around listening to a copy of this show illegally download through Kazaa or Bearshare or whatever we were using at the time.

He ended up passing away 8-9 months after that and has always been my favorite comic. He just had a style, uniqueness, and aura that I've rarely encountered elsewhere. I know that pretty much everyone on the internet is obsessed with him and makes Mitch references, but I'll never forget him as the first comedian I truly loved.

Yeah, it was tough losing him. I had been paying attention to him once I saw his special. I was fortunate enough to see him live three times and he was always great. He was just naturally funny. He inspired me to start doing stand-up, actually.

Do you have Mitch All Together? The set includes his 30-minute special on DVD--but the real treat is that it includes the FULL 60 MINUTE TAPING. For the first half, Mitch BOMBED, which makes the part that aired all the more interesting because Mitch keeps going in spite of having basically lost the audience AND HE WINS THEM BACK. It's pretty great.
